title: Coral Groove
blurb: Swim through pearl bubbles, coral castles and spinning tides in a bright living reef.

levels.name: Reef Welcome
levels.intro: Break the orange pegs among the reef fish. Catch the ball to keep it.

levels.name: Pearl Bubbles
levels.intro: Collect every pearl gem floating in the bubbles.

levels.name: Sea Fans
levels.intro: Break the orange pegs in the colourful sea fans.

levels.name: Starfish Sand
levels.intro: Clear the starfish and all the little pegs around them.

levels.name: Lantern Jellyfish
levels.intro: Light every lantern in the jellyfish and their trailing tentacles.

levels.name: Clam Shell
levels.intro: Break the orange pegs inside the open clam.

levels.name: Glass Tide
levels.intro: Break every glass brick. The ball flies through shattered glass.

levels.name: Shoal Shuffle
levels.intro: Collect the gems as two shoals swim past each other.

levels.name: Anemone Arms
levels.intro: Break the orange pegs. Lightning helps reach between the anemone arms.

levels.name: Sunken Treasure
levels.intro: Collect every gem around the treasure chest. The blue key opens its gate.

levels.name: Turtle Crossing
levels.intro: Break the orange pegs on a sea turtle and its wake.

levels.name: Reef Rhythm
levels.intro: Build a chain of twelve hits in one shot. Multiball can help.

levels.name: Twin Currents
levels.intro: Light every lantern. The paired portals carry the ball across the reef.

levels.name: Coral Castle
levels.intro: Break all the castle bricks. Fire and blasts break the armour too.

levels.name: Dancing Seahorses
levels.intro: Break the orange pegs as the seahorses drift up and down.

levels.name: Deep Sea Glow
levels.intro: Light the lanterns around the dark vent. Keep clear of the black hole.

levels.name: Pearl Carousel
levels.intro: Collect the gems on the spinning pearl rings.

levels.name: Lionfish Lace
levels.intro: Break the orange pegs. Avoid the spikes around the lionfish.

levels.name: Tidal Spiral
levels.intro: Break the orange pegs in the turning tide. Catch plates switch to bounce and back.

levels.name: Heart of the Reef
levels.intro: Break the orange pegs for the reef finale. Lightning and multiball light the way.
